title: Adult obesity crude prevalence, CDC PLACES model estimate (2023 reference)
method: Project the published PLACES 2025 GIS-friendly county obesity crude prevalence and its corresponding reported 95% model confidence interval, without adjustment, imputation or aggregation.
warnings: Model-based estimates, not direct county observation.
Do not use for causal estimates of local intervention effectiveness.
Obesity measure refers to 2023 BRFSS input period despite 2025 dataset release.
